text.p: To add TraceRecorder in a FreeRTOS system, follow the Getting Started guide on our website.

Note: The above guide is intended for the official version of FreeRTOS from freertos.org. If using the Espressif ESP-IDF version of FreeRTOS, try this guide instead: https://percepio.com/getstarted/latest/html/esp-idf.html.
You find the TraceRecorder source code in the $PNAME installation directory, under the FreeRTOS folder.
